method: LinkeDOM + Node VM, stubbed SDK/API only; no rendered browser or live digital-human session

generation displays LIMEN while working, then a collapsed downloadable report
completed report opens its own evaluation with selectable evidence sections
editing basic data invalidates old report; regeneration uses updated values
editing questionnaire invalidates report until the questionnaire is confirmed again
failed report preparation preserves inputs and offers retry
generation cannot overwrite a reset or edited profile from an older pending frame
existing 14 templates and 28 paths retain usable independent drafts and exports
user text remains escaped in report presentation and preserved in downloaded Markdown
routes have unique IDs and correct active stages without a universal left sidebar
reduced motion retains plant poster; bridge never plays
reset clears both modules, generated snapshot, draft tasks and exports state
profile entry artwork is generated, local and independently labelled
library exposes six chapters for all ten directions and 60 independent detail routes
library searches content, recovers from empty filters and includes medicine-specific sources
community starts without fabricated posts, has background video and internal navigation
offline forum draft validates, preserves, escapes and exports without fake publication
studio drawers expand independently and Escape restores the launching control
all five interview exercises retain separate answers and appear in exports
plan export uses a confirmed snapshot and flags changed or missing profiles
file preview connection offers the formal platform without contacting an API
same-origin avatar adapter connects only on request, routes presenter and sends no implicit profile
typed text, microphone, interrupt and task-step changes preserve the actual stage mount
fresh profile must be read and explicitly sent; stale profile cannot leak
leaving the studio releases the session and ignores callbacks from the old session
cancelled initial connection cannot attach itself after route navigation
avatar API configuration failures remain visible and retryable
community reads same-origin posts, filters and escapes all user content

limitations: No rendered local browser verification due earlier URL safety rejection
No live digital-human, microphone, native download or community OTP/publish verification
Local structured reports without AI or official scoring
file:// community uses in-memory drafts; same-origin hosting required for backend
No new knowledge refresh or database tests
